A small fix for people who search through Jackett.

## Fixed
- Jackett searches no longer come back empty when one of your sites is slow. Compass now asks each Jackett site on its own, so the others' results always show up, and the slow site is named in the notice at the top.
- Compass waits a little longer for slow sites before giving up.

## Install
- **Linux:** the `.deb` (recommended) or the `.AppImage`. With the `.AppImage`, install qBittorrent first: `sudo apt install qbittorrent-nox`.
- **Windows:** the `setup.exe`. Install [qBittorrent](https://www.qbittorrent.org/download) first.

Only download what you have the right to download.
